facts.text: Tim has a bookshelf that includes a picture from MinaLima, the company responsible for creating props for the Harry Potter films.

evidence.quote: That picture is from MinaLima. They created all the props for the Harry Potter films, and I love their work. It's like having a piece of the wizarding world at home!

facts.text: John expressed admiration for Tim's bookshelf and the picture on it, calling it interesting.

evidence.quote: Wow, nice bookshelf! That picture is really interesting.

facts.text: Tim mentioned that the picture from MinaLima is part of his collection of reminders that help him escape reality.

evidence.quote: I have lots of reminders of it - kind of a way to escape reality.
